quality_sampling: random full-S500 original RSFISH catalog rows, retaining valid N5 source chunks and peak SNR>4; at most 120/gene
estimated_FWHM: 3D native fluorescence 25x25x17 voxel around detected centroid; ring-median local baseline; halfmax width contiguous in native XY and Z. Not a PSF model or calibrated optical-resolution estimate.
limits: Different imaging rounds, z-dependent blur; brightness selected by detector, not universal optical focus across all attempted spots. Pixel XY .23µm and Z .42µm. One animal/section.
